name: Sichuan Hexie Shuangma Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Hexie Shuangma Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale building material products in China. It offers cement, commercial clinker, and aggregates used for infrastructure, industrial park construction, municipal livelihood projects, commercial housing development, urban renewal, and rural revitalization. The company is also involved in biopharmaceutical research and development and production business; and private equity investment fund management business.
